lanes.PROBLEM: Find open-source solutions to problems FTN already has an active ticket/roadmap item for.
lanes.CAPABILITY: Find emerging open-source capability FTN could use even without a current ticket -- not ranked primarily by star count.
lanes.ARCHITECTURE: Find infrastructure that could replace a planned build or become shared FTN infrastructure -- "what are we about to build that already exists?"

queries.why: Improve browser-local creation, export and interoperability without uploading a creator's audio.
Improve processing, analysis and local-audio workflows while keeping streamed media rights-safe.
Strengthen the FTN dispatcher, provenance and Caribbean-relevant intelligence interfaces.
Improve trust, performance, accessibility and FTN-owned data interfaces across nodes.
Scan for real capability FTN doesn't have an open ticket for yet, so ibis's own current roadmap isn't the only lens FTN sees new capability through.
Before FTN builds a new subsystem from scratch, check whether real, licensable infrastructure already solves it.
